changelog: Corrects Full HD selection to accept widescreen 1920x960 and 1920x800 trailer uploads while excluding 720p, 1440p and 4K. Tries up to three eligible uploads per movie when a source is age-restricted or lacks the requested format, within the existing per-pool acquisition budget. Summarizes expected skips without exception stacks and flags extraction/runtime warnings separately. Preserves genre matching, pool limits, settings and per-user watched history.
description: Maintains separate recent and upcoming regular-movie and anime-movie trailer pools and plays same-genre trailers before movies.
name: Trailer Reel
overview: Recent and upcoming same-genre regular and anime movie trailers as Jellyfin prerolls.
